criteria.behavior: Production capture accepts only after local readiness, uses one provider and bounded ordered PCM per turn, displays matching local partials, and makes one WHOLE-HOLD final after Fn-up/drain. Internal EOU is provisional; later correction/negation retained. The release-anchored safety watchdog is min(8, max(2, 1.2 + 0.3 * sealedCapturedSeconds)) seconds and covers drain/refinement and the same gate-finalization window; it is not a relaxed latency target. Warm final <=200ms is reported separately, and dispatch/effect budgets in P3-7 remain unchanged. >30s capture never silently truncates. Lost audio/failed refinement invalidates admission.

Include old response with fresh call ID during new miss, both duplicate decoding paths, response-created ambiguity and unknown/unbound IDs. implementation-contract.md section3 is binding.
criteria.expected: No commit/response on local hit; one initial reasoning response per miss; duplicate and cross-turn tools blocked; zero image/cloud-transcription sends.
